notes: No bachelor's program in computer science or an equivalent computing degree. The official undergraduate program list (https://catalog.jefferson.edu/academic-programs/undergraduate-programs/, saved as v2c-thomas-jefferson-programs) lists only Information Technology (BS), Healthcare Information Systems (Undergraduate Certificate), Computational Design Minor and Geographic Information Systems Minor among computing-related undergraduate offerings. The BS in Information Technology is a degree-completion program, not a CS or computing-science major, so no frame courses were collected.
